Python with function docstring, verify docstring count

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ProcessConfig, process } from "@xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack";
function main() {
  const config: ProcessConfig = { docstrings: true, language: "python" };
  const result = process("def greet(name):\n    \"\"\"Say hello to someone.\"\"\"\n    return f\"Hello {name}\"\n", config);
  console.log(result.language);
  console.log(result.metrics?.totalLines);
}

void main();
```
